name: record-crate
description: A beautiful local browser for a Discogs record collection

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-ort.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p . && vite build --config vite.app.config.ts
scripts.snapshot: npm run labels && node scripts/export.mjs && node scripts/embed.mjs
scripts.labels: .venv/bin/python scripts/fetch-label-photos.py && node scripts/embed-label-photos.mjs && .venv/bin/python -m identify.labels --build && .venv/bin/python -m identify.discs --prepare && node scripts/embed-label-photos.mjs --crops && .venv/bin/python -m identify.discs --build
